title: [v0.92.1][DRT-A] Distributed qualification contract
body:
## Outcome

Produce one deterministic distributed-qualification and ACIP replay contract.

## Primary deliverable

One deterministic distributed-qualification and ACIP replay contract.

## Verification result

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly acceptance of one distributed-qualification contract; conformance checks are evidence inputs.

- None.

- #182

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Requirements 181 and 182 are mapped
- [ ] Identity and authority are deterministic

- Replay can change authority

- Observatory redesign
